note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To-Do list', 'Help', user avatar

Left sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; project name header is subtracted as it is user-defined
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project path and issue number; treated as trusted navigation chrome

Right sidebar metadata -- renders: 'Assignee', 'Labels', 'Milestone', 'Due date', 'Weight', 'Time tracking', 'Locking', 'Participants', 'Move issue' and their associated controls; values are masked by default
Issue header controls -- renders: 'Edit', 'Close', 'Reopen', 'Add reaction', 'Create merge request', 'Related issues' label; issue title, description, and related issue links are subtracted
Comment form controls -- renders: 'Write', 'Preview', formatting buttons, 'Comment', 'Comment & Close', 'Add to description' checkbox
Discussion section chrome -- renders: 'Comments' heading, 'Sort by' dropdown; the list of user comments is subtracted
